## Puzzle submission checklist

If this PR adds or changes a puzzle, please confirm:

- [ ] The filename is a sensible id (kebab-case, no spaces) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#puzzle-id).
- [ ] Every `palette` entry is a valid hex color (e.g. `#c0392b`).
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` all pass locally.
- [ ] The puzzle content is original or appropriately licensed for inclusion in this project.
